items.detail: Kimi's paper underlines the importance of the right security boundary for agents to run in. tl:DR: container-level isolation is not enough. In their experiments, agents crashed the underlying machine (via kernel panics). Firecracker microVMs (as in Vercel Sandbox) are safe.
items.detail_zh: Guillermo Rauch 指出 Kimi 的研究强调了为 AI Agent 构建正确安全边界的重要性。实验表明，仅靠容器级隔离（container-level isolation）不足以保证安全，Agent 甚至可能导致底层机器崩溃（kernel panics）。相比之下，使用 Firecracker 微型虚拟机（如 Vercel Sandbox 所采用的技术）才能确保运行安全性。

Knowledge could no longer be offloaded to institutions. Humans increasingly had to simulate, plan, and reason locally rather than rely on civilization as external memory. items.detail: Opus 5 is a great model for coding, data analysis, design, biology, knowledge work. More than any of these eval scores, what is most exciting to me is something else: Opus 5 is our least prompt injectable model yet. It is a bit buried in the system card, but across PI evals and red teaming, Opus 5 is very hard to prompt inject successfully. And when layering defenses -- strong model alignment, combined with prompt injection probes, combined with Auto Mode in Claude Code -- the success rate for prompt injection attacks drops to ~0. This is new and exciting! More about this soon.
